title: Infinite recursion in RCTProfileTrampoline

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body: ### Description Infinite recursion in RCTProfileTrampoline In [Detox Instruments](https://github.com/wix/DetoxInstruments), we have added the ability to record RN profiling events. We do this by providing callbacks using `RCTProfileRegisterCallbacks` and then enabling the profiling on a bridge using `RCTProfileInit`. To avoid user setup, we swizzle `-[RCTBridge setUp]` to listen to bridge creation and we call `RCTProfileInit` to enable profiling for that bridge. We are now trying to integrate these Detox Instruments capabilities in Detox, so that we can capture these events when testing. Our code works until either the user presses CMD+R to reload the bridge. Upon reload, the following can be seen: I am not sure if this is due to API misues, or a bug the RN profiling hooking (swizzling) or the trampoline itself. Please assist. React Native version: ``` React Native Environment Info: System: OS: macOS 10.14.5 CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4870HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz Memory: 576.82 MB / 16.00 GB Shell: 5.3 - /bin/zsh Binaries: Node: 12.1.0 - /usr/local/bin/node Yarn: 1.16.0 - /usr/local/bin/yarn npm: 6.9.0 - /usr/local/bin/npm Watchman: 4.9.0 - /usr/local/bin/watchman SDKs: iOS SDK: Platforms: iOS 12.2, macOS 10.14, tvOS 12.2, watchOS 5.2 IDEs: Xcode: 10.2.1/10E1001 - /usr/bin/xcodebuild npmPackages: react: 16.8.3 => 16.8.3 react-native: 0.59.8 => 0.59.8 npmGlobalPackages: react-native-cli: 2.0.1 react-native-git-upgrade: 0.2.4 ``` ### Steps To Reproduce To make it easier to test, I've taken the Detox demo project and adapted it for easy debugging. I've included all the source code of both Detox.framework and DTXProfiler.framework so that it's easy to debug. 1. Clone the project using ```git clone https://github.com/wix/Detox.git --branch infinite_RCTProfileTrampoline``` 2. Navigate to `Detox/test` 3. `npm install` 4. `react-native start` 5. Open `example.xcodeproj` in Xcode 6. Build and run for a simulator The project has been set up so that it starts recording profiling events after 10 seconds of launch and tries to reload the bridge 15 seconds after launch. Look for the `👋` emojis. After step 2 is printed in the log, the process should be at 100+% CPU usage due to the bug. Describe what you expected to happen: There should be no infinite recursion. Snack, code example, or link to a repository: https://github.com/wix/Detox/tree/infinite_RCTProfileTrampoline
